events.body:
Driver-cancelled ride with a no-show claim: NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2 (cancelled_by = driver, $6.61 fee on record) [F4][NS-0]. NS-1 requires all three of (i) arrival confirmation, (ii) being at the pickup at that moment, and (iii) waiting more than 3 minutes continuously at the pickup after the confirmation. (i) is met — the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 [F6][NS-1]. (ii) is met — 39 m from the pickup at the tap, closest approach 38 m [F6][F1][NS-1].

(iii) fails: the driver stayed within 200 m for only 175 s (2 min 55 s) after the 13:02:35 tap, short of the 180 s threshold, so the wait was not "more than 3 minutes" as NS-1 requires; the earlier time inside the radius (platform arrival 13:01:00, 4 min 30 s before cancellation) does not count, because NS-1 measures only the period after the arrival confirmation [F2][F5][F6][NS-1]. The trace marks NS-1 (iii) ✗ accordingly.

Because NS-1 (iii) is not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full [F7][NS-2]. The flag_account limb of NS-2 is not triggered — the trace confirms the arrival confirmation was not made while the driver was outside the pickup radius (39 m at tap) [F1][F6][NS-2]; the driver's belief that he had waited over 3 minutes [F12][F10] does not change the measured 175 s. Rider profile (0 disputes in 90 d, no-show 0) is noted but does not decide anything [F16]. Driver profile (1 upheld no-show dispute in 90 d) could support a flag only if the case were established against him, which it is not here [F17][RD-6].

Amount: the disputed item is the cancellation fee of $6.61, refunded in full — $6.61 [F7][NS-2]. Per NS-7 the refund is issued as a Ryde voucher and Ryde retains final discretion [NS-7].

Safety screen: chat #1 "Reached, blue Toyota Prius, waiting at the pickup" and chat #2 "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel", the post-trip driver statement, and the rider's complaint contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — only a routine pickup/cancellation exchange [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. Nothing to escalate on safety grounds.

Evidence: the record is complete — timestamped chat with both messages, arrival tap and GPS coverage of the wait without a hole, and the fee amount — so every element of the NS-1/NS-2 ruling is settled [F11][F2][F6][F7].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news — your dispute is resolved in your favour. We looked at the driver's arrival record for your pickup and found he waited less than three minutes at the pickup after confirming he had arrived, so the no-show rule wasn't met. The $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full, as a Ryde voucher added to your account. No further action is needed from you, and nothing changes on your account. Thanks for flagging it — this record also helps us keep pickup waits fair for riders.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation and the $6.61 fee. Your arrival confirmation at the pickup was recorded, but the time you then spent waiting at the pickup came to just under three minutes — slightly short of what the no-show rule requires — so the fee isn't being kept. The $6.61 goes back to the rider as a Ryde voucher. This is not an account action against you: your account stays in good standing and nothing is being flagged. If you think the recorded wait time is wrong, reply and we'll take another look at the trip record.
